advisoryFindings.title: Add Non-Finite MaxAttempts Boundaries
advisoryFindings.rationale: The current tests cover lower bound, fractional, upper bound overflow, and valid edges, so the acceptance requirement has meaningful coverage; these extra cases would harden the integer contract.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider adding static cases for `NaN`, `Infinity`, and string values such as `"1"` to the `maxAttempts` constructor/command rejection matrix.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current tests cover lower bound, fractional, upper bound overflow, and valid edges, so the acceptance requirement has meaningful coverage; these extra cases would harden the integer contract.
